specifications.fixture: Task T grants one click on window W, session S, element E, using an independent immutable admission context.
cases: Empty task/target, nonfinite expiry/budget, or mismatched context must produce zero fake dispatches. Current v2 accepts empty/nonfinite values and does not compare task/target against independent context.
One fake effect with a lost reply, followed by confirmed reconciliation, must consume the original one-action allowance. Current reuse permits a second effect.
specifications.repair_target: Trusted task/version/target/session/element/payload binding; finite and nonempty validation; durable allowance reservation before dispatch; enforced independent identity/focus prerequisite.

specifications.fixture: A's token L1 expires at time 10; B acquires L2.
cases: No token, a fabricated token or stale L1 must not dispatch, including a transfer between journaling and effect.

Modeled race: pause A before expired-lease deletion or after its final release check; B acquires L2; resume A. Current input never validates leases; modeled stale reclaimers both return tokens and stale release deletes L2.
specifications.repair_target: Effect-time controller-bound token validation; serialized generation comparison, reclaim, publication and release; fencing of the old dispatcher or proof of quiescence before transfer. Repeated reads alone are insufficient.

specifications.fixture: A and B use an explicitly shared stable journal and the same operation O.
cases: A reserves intent, performs one fake effect, then the confirmation write fails after truncation. Reopen and retry O. Current truncation loses the barrier and permits a second effect.
Pause A after its pending check; B dispatches O and loses the reply; resume A. Current behavior also permits two effects.
specifications.repair_target: Atomic serialized intent reservation; append-only resolution or transactional storage; durable intent before transport; no truncation of uncertainty; stable operation identity bound to task/version/payload.

qualification: Lock races were modeled with in-memory inode/link behavior, not proven through native concurrent processes. The native os.link path was denied after 11 passing checks and was stopped without retry or access changes; the supplied model run passed 32 checks. Default temporary PID-scoped journals mean restart/takeover needs an explicitly shared stable journal; that configuration requirement is a qualification limit, not a demonstrated production failure.
scope: Newly authored synthetic teaching specifications only; no private code copied and no new tests or live actions were performed for this supplement. Existing input/takeover hold and repair scope remain unchanged.
next_action: Use these minimal cases to return a narrowly revised candidate and targeted regression evidence.
